context: This criteria evaluates the correct usage of agent-level configuration to set defaults that apply across multiple requests.

checklist.name: Agent configuration
checklist.description: Creates an agent and configures default settings using methods like .set(), .auth(), or .timeout() on the agent

checklist.name: Default inheritance
checklist.description: Demonstrates that requests made through the agent automatically inherit the configured defaults

checklist.name: Multiple defaults
checklist.description: Configures multiple types of defaults (e.g., headers, auth, timeout) on the same agent
